scientific_integrity: Proof establishes the infinite-dimensional reduction, strictness and universality; a standard-library checker verifies independent exact rational finite certificates plus a proven uniform tail estimate. No experimental data are represented as a proof of infinite claims. Historical priority is provisional.
scientific_limitations: The general sharp weight is defined by a compact operator norm. At least two, but not all, parity ties are classified. The theorem covers the unit 2-sphere, positive heat times, one latitude coordinate and nonnegative subtraction weights.
title: Zonal dominance and two parity reversals for signed axial spherical heat covariances
